commands.name: extract
commands.functionality: Get information from one or more agents by sending prompts and receiving answers
commands.example: What does BackendAgent know about API? / Узнай у агента про API

commands.name: create_agent
commands.functionality: Create a new specialized agent with a role prompt

commands.name: list_agents
commands.example: What agents are in the system? / Какие агенты есть?

commands.name: add
commands.functionality: Add new data or knowledge to an agent
commands.example: Save this report to BackendAgent / Добавь знание агенту

commands.name: delete
commands.functionality: Delete data or entry from an agent
commands.example: Remove outdated data from DevOpsAgent / Удали устаревшие данные

commands.name: edit
commands.functionality: Modify or update existing data inside an agent
commands.example: Update record in BackendAgent / Измени запись в агенте

commands.name: load
commands.functionality: Load a file into an agent for processing
commands.example: Load report.pdf into DevOpsAgent / Загрузи файл в агента

commands.name: consolidate
commands.functionality: Merge two or more agents into one new agent and remove originals
commands.example: Merge BackendAgent and DevOpsAgent into PlatformAgent

commands.name: split
commands.functionality: Split one agent into two specialized agents and remove original
commands.example: Split FullstackAgent into BackendAgent and FrontendAgent
